question: Dry run of 25.09 on the team VM (7290873): `scripts/dry_run.sh <bags>/roundT_doubleT --expect-clear --max-alarm-frames 2` failed with 3 alarm frames at 111.0-114.9 m in every ROS capture. The alarm is one column 0.3-1.1 m off the far axis, tracked 149 -> 101 m: frames that show more than cluster.column_min_height (2.2 m) of it demote it as 'column', frames that show 1.6-2.2 m match no signature, and 6 of the last 10 hits in the gauge make an obstacle (EXPERIMENTS.md section 3a).
fix: tracking.column_hold (int, 0 = off): a track whose cluster was demoted as a column in at least column_hold of its last tracking.zone_window (10) hits is advisory (zone 'warning'); it can only turn a gauge track advisory, never add an alarm

preregistered.note: written before any candidate run on this code (748bb3c: wf5/clear-alarm with claude/nifty-pascal-lzgl78 afa5ae1 merged, cluster.floating_long_min_bottom 1.6); applied as written
preregistered.text:
Candidates: tracking.column_hold 3, 2, 1. Choice: the HIGHEST candidate that satisfies both (a) and (b); if none does, ship 0 (off) and report.
(a) On every one of the 10 ROS captures of roundT_doubleT of 25.09 on the team VM (docs/evidence: dry_run_2026-09-25/{dry_clear, host_cyclonedds, host_fastdds, console_image, console_stock_dds}, bench_2026-09-25/{dry_clear_native, dry_clear_numpy, ct_image, ct_stock}, offline_2026-09-25/dry_clear; recording 1 = /lidar_points), the frames that would stay alarms number <= 2. Counted from the captures: an alarm frame (obstacle true) stays an alarm when at least one of its gauge detections belongs to a track with fewer than column_hold column hits among its last 10 hits up to and including this frame. The hits of a track are its reports in the capture (detections + warnings with the same id, one per frame); a report whose cluster is identical to the track's previous report (size, n_points, height_min, lateral) is a hold over a missed frame, not a hit; a column hit is a hit with reason 'column'. (The column_hold rule cannot create an alarm, so no other frame can become one.)
(b) python scripts/regression_gate.py --cache /data/cache --jobs 3 --set tracking.column_hold=<v> --baseline docs/evidence/results/regression_baseline_2026-09-25_ride.json: no gated row worse and none missing (exit 0), with the ride (new_data, 8 pieces) and set F straight included.
Order: 3 first; (a) is evaluated first and the gate is run only for a candidate that passes (a); stop at the first candidate that passes both (higher is preferred).
Recorded per candidate: the capture counts, the gate summary (verdict, gated rows better / worse), five bags, ride, set O, set F straight.
